3. Tarun correctly solved a pair of linear equations in two variables and found their 1
only point of intersection as (5, – 1). One of the lines was x – y = 6.
Which of the following could have been the other line?
I: 3x – 3y = 18
II: 2x – 3y = 13
III: 2x – 3y = 16
(A) I only (B) II only (C) I and II (D) II and III
